// A keyed lookup collection. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Associative_array)
interface IMap<TKey, TValue>
    inherits ICountable
{
    ContainsKey(x: Self, key: TKey): Boolean;
    ValueAt(x: Self, key: TKey): TValue;
}
